Email alerts

Get an email when the Polish sovereign curve moves by more than a threshold you set. Register below, confirm the link we send you, then pick your metrics and thresholds. Alerts are evaluated once a day, after the daily LW-NSS fit, comparing against the previous fitting day. Free; unsubscribe with one click in any email.

Register

By registering you agree to receive alert emails at the address above. We store only your email and your thresholds, use them solely for these alerts, and delete them when you unsubscribe.

Your settings

Market thresholds

Alert fires when the 1-day absolute change exceeds the threshold (bp). Up to 12 rules.

Site news

Occasional emails when something new appears on the site (no fixed cadence, typically a few per month).

Metrics from the daily LW-NSS fit on Treasury BondSpot Poland fixings and NBP reference rates. This is an information service, not investment advice.
